description_en: Queries accelerated domain names by origin server
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainsBySource按源站查询加速域名
name: DescribeDomainsBySource

parameters.help_en: The origin servers. Separate multiple origin servers with commas (,). Fuzzy match is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 源站，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔，不支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: sources

DomainsData.description_en: The array of DomainsData elements, which returns the list of domain names corresponding to each origin server
DomainsData.description_zh: 由DomainsData组成的数组格式，返回各个源站对应的域名名称列表

items.description_en: The array of DomainsData elements, which returns the list of domain names corresponding to each origin server
items.description_zh: 由DomainsData组成的数组格式，返回各个源站对应的域名名称列表

domainInfo.description_en: The list of domainInfo elements, which returns the detailed information of the domain names
domainInfo.description_zh: 由domainInfo组成的列表格式，返回域名的详细信息

items.description_en: The list of domainInfo elements, which returns the detailed information of the domain names
items.description_zh: 由domainInfo组成的列表格式，返回域名的详细信息

CdnType.description_en:
The business type of the accelerated domain name. Valid values:

web: Images and small files.

download: Large file downloads.

video: On-demand video/audio streaming
CdnType.description_zh:
加速域名的业务类型。取值：

web：图片小文件。

download：大文件下载。

video：视音频点播

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time. The time is formatted in ISO 8601 and includes a UTC offset
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，并包含 UTC 偏移量

Status.description_en:
The status of the domain name. Valid values:

applying: Under review.
configuring: Being configured.
online: Running normally.
stopping: Stopping.
offline: Stopped.
disabling: Being deleted
Status.description_zh:
域名状态。取值：

applying：审核中
configuring：配置中
online：正常运行
stopping：停止中
offline：停止
disabling：删除中

UpdateTime.description_en: The update time. The time is formatted in ISO 8601 and includes a UTC offset
UpdateTime.description_zh: 更新时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，并包含 UTC 偏移量

domainNames.description_en: The list of domainNames elements, which returns the list of domain names corresponding to a single domain name
domainNames.description_zh: 由domainNames组成的列表格式，返回单个域名对应的域名名称列表

items.description_en: The list of domainNames elements, which returns the list of domain names corresponding to a single domain name
items.description_zh: 由domainNames组成的列表格式，返回单个域名对应的域名名称列表
